atAGlance: Sinh tố chanh dây blends passion fruit into a tart, floral smoothie that keeps its bright tropical perfume even with milk and ice.
whatItIs: Sinh tố chanh dây is passion fruit blended with ice, sugar, and sometimes milk. Expect passion fruit smoothie that is tart, floral, bright, and fragrant through the straw.
howToEnjoy: Keep some sugar unless you love sharp sour drinks; passion fruit can be intense.
howLocalsOrder: Sinh tố chanh dây has natural tartness, so ask less sugar only if you enjoy a sharper fruit taste. Less ice makes the smoothie thicker and more fragrant.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Sinh tố chanh dây captures Vietnam’s love of bright tropical acidity, especially in hot-weather café drinks.
goodToKnow: Seeds or pulp may be part of the texture.
